note: Not a support-matrix row and never certifiable. This plan exists so the required CI job exercises the real collector-to-validator path on a real host at the exact commit under test: it runs a genuine command, captures its real output into a content-addressed artifact, and validates the record that results. A hosted CI runner has no GPU, no audio device and no clean Windows install, so it cannot supply evidence for any stable-v1 row; PLT-200 stays open until a physical host does.
